title: Kostoly na Slovensku
description: Comprehensive directory of churches, chapels, basilicas, cathedrals and Christian places of worship across Slovakia. Sourced from 27 sk.wikipedia categories (parent + 8 kraj + 6 style + 12 denomination/type) with subcategory expansion and Wikidata enrichment. Covers Roman Catholic, Greek Catholic, Lutheran (Evanjelická a.v.), Calvinist Reformed (Reformovaná), Eastern Orthodox (Pravoslávna), Cirkev bratská and architectural styles from Romanesque to Functionalist.

meta.title: Kostoly na Slovensku - Bezplatné stiahnutie
meta.description: Comprehensive directory of churches, chapels, basilicas, cathedrals and Christian places of worship across Slovakia. Sourced from 27 sk.wikipedia categories (parent + 8 kraj + 6 style + 12 denomination/type) with subcategory expansion and Wikidata enrichment. Covers Roman Catholic, Greek Catholic, Lutheran (Evanjelická a.v.), Calvinist Reformed (Reformovaná), Eastern Orthodox (Pravoslávna), Cirkev bratská and architectural styles from Romanesque to Functionalist. Obsahuje 370 záznamov. Stiahnuť vo formátoch Excel, CSV, PDF.
